content:
Three spheres, three pairs, three tangent points. The tangent point between two equal spheres lies at the midpoint between their centers. The centers form an equilateral triangle in a plane parallel to the ground (all at height 3). The midpoints of the sides of an equilateral triangle form another (smaller) equilateral triangle.

**triangle**
